# @codenhub/validation

> Zero-dependency schema validation for TypeScript. Build a schema with `val`, run unknown input through it, and get the typed value or every issue found. Extend it with custom checks, transforms, async rules and localizable messages. The package is experimental.

Schemas are immutable and inferred with `Infer`. `validate` returns a result and never throws for invalid input; `parse` throws a `ValidationError`; async rules need `validateAsync` or `parseAsync`. Every schema implements Standard Schema v1. Issues never contain the input unless `includeInput` is set.

## Documentation

- [Documentation overview](docs/index.md): Schemas, results, execution modes and objects.
- [Validator reference](docs/validators.md): Every `val` factory and rule with its failure code.
- [Customization](docs/customization.md): `refine`, `check`, `transform`, `pipe`, `val.custom`, async rules, context and reusable checks.
- [Errors and messages](docs/errors.md): Issue shape, codes and `params`, message functions, localization and form errors.
- [Coercion](docs/coercion.md): `val.coerce.*` and `val.json` for text input such as environment variables.
- [Changelog](docs/changelog/index.md): Release notes and 0.0.1 migration.
